name: L'Amant Secret

menus.name: Dinner chef's tasting
menus.note: Tuesday to Saturday. Caviar and blue egg course ₩105,000 extra; mint and chocolate chip dessert ₩20,000 extra.

menus.name: Lunch chef's tasting
menus.note: Tuesday to Saturday. A shorter menu; caviar and blue egg ₩105,000 extra.

bookingOpens: Online through Catchtable only, since 1 December 2025; bookings for up to four. Lunch is 12pm to 3pm (last order 1:30pm) and dinner 6pm to 10pm (last order 7:30pm).
cancellation: Deposits are refunded in full for cancellations or changes two days ahead, half one day ahead, and not at all on the day. Arriving more than 15 minutes late without warning can count as a no-show. Changes to numbers on the day are difficult.
groups: Groups of up to six only in the private room (₩100,000 room charge), booked by email to lamantsecret@lescapehotel.com.
dressCode: Business casual. No tracksuit trousers, slippers or sandals, and no shorts for men.
byob: Wine corkage ₩100,000 a 750ml bottle: one bottle for 1 to 5 guests, two for 6 (not at events or on Christmas Eve and Christmas Day).
